(na)༄༅/ /thub dbang dang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi sgom bzlas dang lung 'bogs tshul byang chub spyod pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu

tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// thub dbang dang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi sgom bzlas dang lung 'bogs tshul byang chub spyod pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwā ya/ rmad byung ston mchog thub pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras thu bo grags chen brgyad// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam thar dang*// bka' drin ldan la gus pas 'dud// de dag re re'ang rjes dran pa'i// phan yon brjod las 'das pa'i phyir// sgrub pa'i thabs dang der 'jug sgo// bzlas lung 'bogs pa'i cho ga bshad// de la gtso bo ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sgom bzlas bka' gdams lha bzhi las 'byung ba ltar nyams su len par 'dod pa la/ thog mar/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum sngon tu btang nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ser po'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing*/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros/ thub pa ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyi phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsgoms la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog khar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dge ba bsngo/

oṃ muḥzhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o// ༈ /nye ba'i sras brgyad las 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgom bzlas ni/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sngon du btang*/ gang ltar yang smon pa byang sems dang stong pa nyid bsgom/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod/ rang gi snying gar pad zla la dhīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ phyag g.yon po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing mi bskyod pas dbu la spras pa/ zur phud lnga pa'am ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs kyi drung du khro bo gshin rje gshed po mthing nag thod pa'i phreng ba can/ g.yas 'jam dpal gyi zhabs la brten pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ g.yon tho ba rwa nyi shu pa 'dzin cing khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o// ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba gsal bar gyur/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ ra ra sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa naṃ/ ku mā ra rū pa dha ri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe stong pa nyid du bsdus nas/ slar lha skur ldang*/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo klog pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'don pa sogs chos spyod ci nus su bya'o// ༈ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas ni/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang phyug mtshan thos pa dang bzung ba tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ba'i 'phags mchog de la ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i mos gus kyi sgo nas/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bskor ba byas la/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags don bsam/

rang gi snying gar hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las 'jig rten mgon po ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i sku lus ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'am/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon gdan la brten pas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa phrag pa g.yon pa la gnas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas brkyangs pa'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i drung du khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ g.yon pas be con dkar po 'dzin pa'o// ye shes pa spyan drang*/ mchod pas mchod/ rang la gzhug oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ye/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ kā ru ṇe kā ru ṇe/ ma hā kā ru ṇa pra tiṣ+ṭha ti kā ru ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ lha sku 'od gsal du bsdus te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ za ma tog bkod pa dang*/ 'phags mchog 'di nyid kyi mtshan brgya sogs 'don no// ༈ /'phags pa phyag na rdo rje'i sgom bzlas ni/ sngags dang rgyud la mngon par dga' ba rnams 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la blo gtad 'cha' dgos te/ sngags rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro// skyabs sems tshad med stong nyid sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la hūm̐/ de las 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus pa las 'phags mchog phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang gu/ rin po che'i prog zhu can/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang*/

g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchog dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu bzhad cing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no// yang na sku mdog sngon por byas kyang rung*/ de'i drung du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ ljang gu'am sngo sangs dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa'o// de nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang*/ sgo gsum byin rlabs snga ma ltar bya/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā badz+ra/ pra tiṣ+ṭha tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī rāt+narga tā ya/ badz+ra shā rī raṃ/ me ku ru badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na swā hā/ snying po'o// lha sku bsdu ldang bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdo dang*/ gsang bdag nyid kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bklog mchod pa dang gtor ma la yang brtson par bya'o// ༈ /'phags pa byams pa mgon po'i sgom bzlas ni/ tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ rang gi snying gar maiṃ dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun byams par gyur/ oṃ mai tri ya tri/ de yang sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ dar gyi smad dkris dang ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten can mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang bcas pa'o// zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul rang gang mos pa bya/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ras mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ mai tri dṛ ḍha tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byin gyis brlab/ snying gar zla ba la sngags phreng bkod la/ oṃ a dzi tañja ya/ sarba satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu ga ta swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o// thun 'jog pa'i tshe stong pa nyid du bsdus nas/

slar lha skur ldang*/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod spyi mthun gang 'grub dang byams pa'i mtshan brgya dang dam bcas pa'i gzungs rnams 'don no// 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i sgom bzlas ni/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ pad zla la rang sems k+ṣiṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sa'i snying po ser po stod g.yogs ser po can/ zhi ba spyan rtsa dmar ba/ me tog sngon po'i phreng ba'i thod can/ phyag g.yas shing tog dang g.yon pad+ma'i steng na nor bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer ljang gu 'phro ba/ rdo rjes 'og la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang ser po/ rin po che'i brag ri dang gangs ris bskor ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa sogs mngon rtogs lhag ma kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha/ ha ra tsa ra/ ma hā pa sha/ mā ru ta/ a mo gha badz+ra san+ta swā hā/ zhes bzla/ mjug tu sku stong par sbyang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshams su sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya gzungs sngags bklag go/ ༈ /'phags pa sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sgom bzlas ni/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang sems skaṃ las rang nyid sgrub pa rnams sel sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng du/ zla ba nya gang ba ra ri med cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyir zlog chen po gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs rig pa'i khro bo mang pos zhabs la btud pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs bzhin no// oṃ a mṛ ta bin+dhu dzā wa/ ma hā su kha swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ rjes dang thun mtshams snga ma 'dra ba las/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya klog pa nyid khyad par ro//

༈ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgom bzlas ni/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ rang gi snying gar khaṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngo sangs can/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi khang bzang 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i dbus na/ khro bo dbyug sngon sogs 'khor rig 'dzin mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang*/ rang gi sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs can mang pos bskor ba/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nas thugs kar hūm̐ gis bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ swa sti ka ma lāk+ṣi/ pi pu la/ saṃ bha wa/ dharma dhā tu/ go tsa re swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o// rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyang snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya klog pa nyid khyad par ro// ༈ /'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sgom bzlas ni/ sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems s+t+waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po sku mdog dmar pa/ g.yas gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon nyi ma dang pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ khro bo ṭāk+ki rā dza dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng bkod do// oṃ s+t+waṃ hrīḥka ya swā hā/ ci nus bzla/ mjug tu sku stong par sbyang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshams su kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pa ci nus su 'don zhing*/

phal po che dang gser 'od dam pa la sogs pa bklag par bya'o// gzhan yang sku gzugs la mchod bstod dang smon lam mang du 'debs pa ni gong ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o// ༈ /da ni de dag gi bzlas lung 'bogs pa'i tshul ni/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la bzlas lung 'bogs pa don med pas rgyud sde bzhi gang rung gi dbang bskur thob pa la sgom bzlas kyi lung sbyin par bya ste thog mar ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la/ thub dbang gi sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ oṃ las byung ba'i mchod par mos/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bi d+ye badz+re/ ma hā te dze badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi man+t+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇa sarba karma ā ba ra ṇe bi sho dha na swā hā/ zhes mchod sprin gyi gzungs bzla/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ ser po las thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni sogs mdun bskyed bzlas pa ci 'grub kyi bar du bya/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyis bstod/ slob ma la chab btang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du sgom bzlas kyi lung zab mo blang bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed cing*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas gsan par zhu/ de yang lus can rnams kyis don du gnyer bya mthar thug pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kho na yin la/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs 'chad pa ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang*/ de las kyang theg pa chen po'i kho na'i khyad chos yin cing de la'ang don spyi ston pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid la brten nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' dag mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chen por gshegs shing gshegs par 'gyur ba ste/

de la'ang 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du byed pa'i thabs rim pa gnyis ni lam 'di'i nyams su blang bya'i rtsa ba yin cing de'i gzhi'am rtsa brgyud smin par byed pa la thug pas de nyid sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la'ang dbang*/ byin rlabs/ rig gtad/ bzlas lung ste rnam pa bzhi'i bye brag can du bzhugs pa las 'dir bya sla zhing bskyed bzlas la dbang bar byed pa bzlas lung 'bogs par byed pa yin/ de'ang lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams dang 'brel ba'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa las 'dir gangs can lha gcig 'od dpag med dngos jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i bka' srol bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan bdag cag gi ston pa bka' drin dang thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i sgom bzlas kyi lung 'bogs pa la thog mar zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ ces mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas bsags sbyong spel gsum gyis rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du yan lag bdun pa lhan cig tu gsung bar zhu/ ji snyed su dag sogs brjod/ theg pa che chung thams cad kyi lam gyi sgrub thabs mtha' dag gi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ de nas bsgom bya'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ltar gsal thob cig stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar sogs nas hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon thub pa'i dbang por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ yig ser po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ mos gus mdzad pas sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mu ni lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/

khyad par ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rig sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ des ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sgom bzlas kyi lung legs par thob pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ dge bsngo bya/ rjes bdag mdun la mchod/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam la 'jug pa sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o// ༈ /de nas nye sras brgyad kyi sgom lung thams cad cho ga gcig kho nas 'gros shes par bya ste/ sku brnyan bris 'bur gang 'dzom sogs rten dang*/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ slob dpon gyis sgom bzlas nyams su blang*/ thams cad dus gcig tu lung 'bogs pa'i skabs 'jam dbyangs nas kun tu bzang po'i bar sgom bzlas rnams mthar chags su btang*/ thun mtshams kyi bya bar bshad pa'i chos spyod rnams 'grub na phan yon gyi yan lag tu 'gyur zhing mi 'grub na'ang chog slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ gral du 'khod la sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de la 'dir skabs su bab pa'i gsan bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang dgongs pa phrin las nye bar mnyam pa'i rgyal sras mchog chen brgyad po 'di dag gdod ma nyid nas mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yang dang yang du bstan kyang 'khor ba'i sems can mu mtha' med pa sgrol ba'i khyu mchog dpa' bo chen po'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che slar yang bzhes te/ nam mkha' dang 'gro ba'i khams ji srid de srid du bzang po spyod pa rgya mtshos chos kyi dbyings rgyas par gtams te mkha' khyab kyi lus can ma bsgral ba mtha' dag yang dag pa'i dbyings su bsgral ba la dus gsum du gshegs pa'i 'dren pa sus kyang bskrun du med pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba ste 'phags pa de dag thams cad kyi sgrub thabs dang sgom lung cha tshang ba sngon chad bod du ma byung ba la/

'di ni 'phags yul lho phyogs ra khang tsag+mar sku 'khrungs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon shākya rak+ṣi ta la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba'i sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad yod pa las/ slob dpon pūr+ṇa badz+ra las rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos sgrub thabs nyer bzhi gsan pa'i nang tshan las byung ba'i nye ba'i sras chen po brgyad kyi bzlas lung sgrub pa lags/ chos 'di gang las brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha swā mī/ su dza ta/ sā dhu dz+nyā na/ saṃ kra kīrti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be dā ban+dhu/ bī ra mi tra/ pār+ṇa badz+ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha nas rim par rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i bar du brgyud pa'i zam ma chad par byon pa lags/ de lta bu'i sgom lung rnams rim par bsgrub par bgyi ba'i dang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku gcig tu bsdus pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i sgom bzlas kyi lung gsan pa'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ ces mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas theg pa che chung gi lam gyi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum/ khyad par du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ slob dpon kyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams gzhan tu ma yengs par lha'i rnal 'byor 'di bzhin du bsgom 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar la/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar pad zla la dhī yig sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bar mngon rtogs ltar brjod/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba/ mos gus mdzad pas sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum grub mthar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ khyad par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig 'dir slob dpon dang phreng ba sbrel ba dang mthar phreng ba slob ma'i mgor 'jog pa'ang phyag len tu 'dug des 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom lung gsan grub pa'i gtang rag dang*/ gnyis pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgom bzlas kyi lung gsan pa'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la skyabs sems nas bzung snga ma ltar btang ba las/ mngon rtogs dang snying po so so'i sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing lha'i mtshan spo/ des thams cad rigs 'gre ste/ gsum pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod mtha' dag 'dzin pa 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i/ zhes dang*/ bzhi pa rgyal tshab lha brgya'i mgon po mi pham byams pa mgon po'i/ zhes dang*/ lnga pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i/ zhes dang*/ drug pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i/ zhes dang*/ bdun pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i/ zhes dang*/ brgyad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sgom bzlas kyi lung*/ zhes bsgyur/ thams cad tshar ba dang gtang rag maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bsngo smon ji ltar 'os pa byas pas 'grub bo// bdag bskyed re re bzhin bsdu ldang byas zin cing mdun bskyed bsgrub mi dgos pas rjes chog med do// ngo mtshar sangs rgyas grangs med byon gyur kyang*// snyigs dus skyob pa thub dbang 'dra ba med// rgyal sras sems dpa' dus gsum gshegs rnams kyis// 'phags mchog brgyad kyi rnam thar 'gran zla bral// de phyir yon tan rjes dran gus pa'i blos// 'brel ba cung zad bzhag kyang don che'i phyir// 'di byas dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar yongs 'grub shog

/ces pa 'di'ang khyab bdag kun mkhyen bla ma rin po che nas bka' lung gi rjes su gnang ba bstsal ba dang*/ rang nyid kyis sngar byas pa'i thub dbang nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa'i mchod chog la'ang 'di dang 'brel na gnad che bar mthong nas/ rgyal ba'i sras po'i mos pa lam byed karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben khrod du sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las khol phyung bklags chog tu bkod pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
